prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the silicone container from mobile robot platform to workbench.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether the two silicone container is on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Centre foreground: two white plastic wash bottles stand upright on square white holder plates mounted to a grey aluminium-framed bench/rail. Each has a red angled spout cap fitted; one bottle bears a green band, the other a blue band. Their contents are not clearly visible through the opaque walls. To the right of them, two empty white circular holder rings/cups sit on the platform, and a blue-topped tray edge appears at lower right.
observations: The workbench contains two white plastic wash bottles and empty holder rings, but no silicone containers are observed.

args.observations: The workbench contains two white plastic wash bottles and empty holder rings, but no silicone containers are observed.
